events.text: Ethiopian forces regain control of Adigrat in the Tigray Region following a withdrawal of Eritrean forces. Celebrations are reported in the city following the withdrawal.
At least 20 people are killed and 18 others are injured in a Russian airstrike on a five-story residential building in Zaporizhzhia, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Ukraine.
Twelve people are killed and 309 more injured in a Houthi missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
The National Hurricane Center reports that Isaias has weakened to a post-tropical cyclone after making landfall near Destin, Florida, United States.
Four people are reported dead after Isaias made landfall in the US, with two deaths reported in Escambia County, Florida, and another two in Alabama.
Simon strengthens into a category 4 Pacific hurricane with 150 mph (240 kph) in winds as it barrels towards Mexico's coast.
A man is killed after jumping into a tiger enclosure and being attacked at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in South Yorkshire, England.

Indian authorities are placing New Delhi under an intense security lockdown and have been detaining thousands of demonstrators to block a massive rally that is being organized by the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party.
In cycling, the 120th edition of the Giro di Lombardia is held, with Paul Seixas winning the race and becoming the youngest person to do so.
